title: How is Benito Mussolini connected to Mario?
description:
Two dictators, a future president, the Terminator and Star-Lord connect Benito Mussolini to Mario.

Benito Mussolini → Francisco Franco → Ronald Reagan → Arnold Schwarzenegger → Chris Pratt → Mario

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Benito Mussolini → Francisco Franco: In 1941, Mussolini met Spain's dictator Francisco Franco on the Italian Riviera, pressing him to join the war.
   Photo by Anonymous (Keystone), Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Entrevista_de_Bordighera_(Franco_y_Mussolini).jpg
2. Francisco Franco → Ronald Reagan: Spain stayed out, and in 1972 Franco received California's governor, Ronald Reagan, in Madrid.
   Photo, CC BY-SA 4.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Francisco_Franco_Ronald_Reagan_1972.jpg
3. Ronald Reagan → Arnold Schwarzenegger: In 1984, President Reagan met Arnold Schwarzenegger, fresh from The Terminator, at the Republican convention.
   Photo by Richie Bendall, CC0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:President_Ronald_Reagan_with_Arnold_Schwarzenegger_Retouched_(cropped).jpg
4. Arnold Schwarzenegger → Chris Pratt: In 2025, Arnold brought his son-in-law, Chris Pratt, to the premiere of his show FUBAR.
   Photo by Charley Gallay/Getty Images, Fair use (commentary): https://www.goodmorningamerica.com/culture/story/arnold-schwarzeneggers-family-supports-fubar-premiere-122790066
5. Chris Pratt → Mario: And in 2023, Chris Pratt became the voice of Mario in the Super Mario Bros Movie.
   Photo by Gage Skidmore, Nintendo / Illumination / Universal Pictures, CC BY-SA 3.0 / Fair use (commentary): https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Chris_Pratt_by_Gage_Skidmore.jpg + https://screen-connections.com/2023/03/09/the-super-mario-bros-movie-final-trailer-main-poster-6-more-character-posters/

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

#benitomussolini #mario #sixdegrees #history #didyouknow #shorts
first_comment: Who should I connect next? Two names, the weirder the better.
